record.provider: NAISS Arrhenius Disk / SENS Storage (Sweden) — 25 PB and 10 PB project storage, applied in GiB

free_tier.stated: Project storage is applied for in GiB through SUPR, with generous upper limits: Arrhenius Disk shows 'Upper Limit 50,000', 'Default Storage 250', 'Available 4,000,000' (GiB. So 50,000 GiB ≈ 48.8 TiB ceiling, 250 GiB default); Klemming 'Upper Limit 100,000' with 'Available 5,850,000' GiB. Arrhenius SENS Storage is a 10 PB system for sensitive data, 'only available as when applying for a related compute resource'.

egress.terms: Free national e-infrastructure; no egress meter documented.

record.tooling: Lustre/POSIX on Arrhenius Disk (rsync/scp/sftp from a login node), no published S3 endpoint for the Disk resource. SUPR is the application portal.
record.chaining: Small allocations are reviewed WEEKLY. 'Proposals are reviewed weekly throughout the year'. So a Swedish-affiliated PI can iterate to the ceiling in weeks rather than waiting for an annual round. Medium is the tier that carries the 50 TB-class ceilings.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: not applicable (POSIX/Lustre). Retention: 'There is no backup of Arrhenius Disk' and storage is tied to the project; NAISS Large requires prior PI status on a Medium project. request-rate: not published. Gate: heavy. 'you must be a scientist in Swedish academia, at least at the level of assistant professor' for Medium, PhD student + 20% appointment for Small, and Large requires 'an appointment of at least 60 percent at a Swedish university'.
record.reliability_note: No backup on Arrhenius Disk or SENS Storage. Several listed resources (Alvis, Mimer) are mid-decommission with allocations being migrated. Check resource status before requesting.

evidence.proved: resource table: 'Arrhenius Disk | NAISS | 50 000 | 250 | 4 000 000' (GiB), 'Klemming | PDC | 100 000 | 500 | 5 850 000'; Alvis and Mimer flagged as decommissioned/migrating
'The total size of Arrhenius Disk is 25 PB. There is no backup of Arrhenius Disk.' Eligibility by tier.
'The total size of Arrhenius SENS Storage is 10 PB. There is no backup'; 'only available as when applying for a related compute resource'
'Proposals are reviewed weekly throughout the year'; 'at least a PhD student and hold an appointment of at least 20 percent at a Swedish university'
